entities.summary: Louis Réard's two-piece swimsuit was so scandalous he named it after Bikini Atoll's nuclear test — explosive impact. No Parisian model would wear it; he hired a nude dancer. The Vatican condemned it. It took 20 years to gain mainstream acceptance.
